text:
arcadia: Heads-up: need a manager-friendly onboarding checklist for a hybrid Data Analyst starting Mon. Fewer infra steps but need access to analytics DBs, Tableau, and Slack channels. Can someone make a concise checklist and a short 30/60/90 with measurable outcomes?
ben: Sure. Key manager items: 1) confirm access list for analytics infra (DB, tableau groups, SSO), 2) schedule intro with data product owners, 3) assign a data steward buddy, 4) first-week data task (reproduce a dashboard metric).
sasha: Add note about granting readonly vs write privileges. Managers should request write access only after 30-day review. Also include data handling training completion (PII basics).
ops-bot: Reminder: People Ops triggers DB access request once manager selects required tools on intake form. Please list exact groups.
arcadia: Good point. Also want a "success at 30 days" blurb: "By 30 days: able to reproduce key dashboard, identify one data quality gap, and own updates for one report."
ben: I'll draft a one-pager and calendar snippet for manager 1:1s and handoff meetings.
sasha: Also recommend an explicit bullet: "Confirm physical desk & data steward seating plan for in-office days."
arcadia: Thanks all. Can you drop the one-pager here by 2pm? We're tight.
ops-bot: Action items: (1) Draft manager one-pager -> ben, (2) Add data training to intake -> people-ops. Due 2pm.
